searchText: I think we need a maintainer for the Jekyll code in the EIPs repository. There are now a couple PRs open that I have zero ability to actually review. @Micah I may be able to help with this and it would be included with my eng work in general with ech. Notably though I don't write jekyll but I'm sure I can figure it out I think at a minimum, we just need someone to understand the Jekyll build process and be able to reasonably evaluate whether a given PR is reasonable or not. I just have no clue if the open PRs are reasonable (I'm sure they are, but I cannot assert that with any confidence beyond "people are generally good"). which prs? <https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/3598> <https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/3599> from what I can see, #3599 doesn't actually bump the dependencies, it just fixes the README and a typo in EIP 3014 Yeah, but I don't know if the changes are correct. If we had a maintainer they would be able to say either "yes, we are using a newer version of Ruby now" or "no, things should build correctly with an older version of Ruby". hmm how do you all feel about this layout for the banner? please ignore what the text says
